rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for referring to one's father.

example.english: My pa is cooking dinner for us tonight.
example.traditional: 爸爸今晚煮飯畀我哋食。
example.jyutping: baa4 baa1 gam1 maan1 zyu2 faan6 bei2 ngo5 dei6 sik6

rows.note: Use this for a paternal grandfather rather than the maternal-grandfather term.

example.english: My pa used to take me to the park all the time.
example.traditional: 爺爺以前成日帶我去公園玩。
example.jyutping: je4 je2 ji5 cin4 seng4 jat6 daai2 ngo5 heoi3 gung1 jyun2 waan2

rows.note: Use this for a maternal grandfather rather than the paternal-grandfather term.

example.english: My pa goes for dim sum every day since he retired.
example.traditional: 我個公公退休之後日日去飲茶。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 gung1 gung1 teoi3 jau1 zi1 hau6 jat6 jat6 heoi3 jam2 caa4
